prompt_alignment.label: Prompt Alignment
prompt_alignment.description: How well does the image realize the intent described in the prompt? (subject, composition, style, colors)

visual_quality.label: Visual Quality
visual_quality.description: Sharpness, lighting, color harmony, no obvious artifacts, no clipping/warping, no extra fingers/limbs (n/a since no humans).

usefulness_as_asset.label: Usefulness as Asset
usefulness_as_asset.description: Would this work as a gallery / blog / X image for the content pack? Does it support the topic clearly?

factual_safety.label: Factual Safety
factual_safety.description: No factual misrepresentation, no fake citations, no hallucinated logos, no fake author names, no real people implied.

brand_text_artifact_risk.label: Brand / Text Artifact Risk
brand_text_artifact_risk.description: Lower = safer. 10 = severe brand confusion, garbled text, fake logos. 0 = pristine, no risk.
brand_text_artifact_risk.scale: 0-10 (lower is better, but score 0-10 normally; final contribution is reversed in overall)
brand_text_artifact_risk.scoring_note: Score like other dimensions; we will subtract risk from overall. (0 = no risk, 10 = severe risk)

decision_thresholds.human_override_note: Human decisions are authoritative. needs_regen may be chosen by 爸爸 even when formula suggests reject; recorded as-is.

items.title: River AI
items.prompt: A developer community discussion poster. topic "River AI" as a short hook at the top in rounded sans-serif. central visual: a stylized developer workspace with three monitors showing code, terminal, and chat. bottom one-liner summarizing the pain point in italics. style: editorial flat illustration, pastel pink and slate, soft shadows, minimal. no faces, no company logos
items.decision_reason: Severe text artifacts in title area ("Develoesin UncerPto"), fake footer/logo text, weak River AI semantic clarity. Developer workflow direction is usable but image not suitable as final asset.
items.reviewer_notes: Regenerate with minimal or no text, no fake logos, cleaner personal-AI/developer-workflow visual.

items.title: stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt
items.prompt: A polished AI model card visual. model name "stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt" shown as a large hero badge. central pipeline flow: input (icon) → model block with subtle inner layers → output (icon). task label "image-to-video" near the input. two or three monospaced metric tiles on the right: downloads, likes, library. style: Hugging Face inspired, dark slate background, amber-to-magenta gradient, soft glow. no human faces, no company logos
items.decision_reason: Reasonable abstract video-diffusion pipeline direction, but scene is too dark, main subject too small, most labels unreadable pseudo-text.
items.reviewer_notes: Regenerate with clearer video generation pipeline visual, stronger central composition, minimal readable labels, no fake UI metrics.
